summary: Adds an Intermediate Exchange to IKEv2, the key-setup protocol used by IPsec, so that large amounts of data can be sent while the security association is being established. A key motivation is key exchange methods that resist quantum computers, which often have very large public values that do not fit well in the initial messages. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: When two computers set up a secret handshake, the first messages are small. This adds a middle step so they can pass bigger notes, like very large secret codes, before finishing the handshake.

questions: how does ikev2 send large key exchange data
what is the ikev2 intermediate exchange
how to use post-quantum keys with ikev2
